en.label: The collaboration workspace
en.description: Bring models and ACP agents together in a local workspace. Give each a role, follow the conversation, and build something together.
en.short: A local workspace where models and agents work together.
features: Your team, your choice
Connect model providers and ACP agents. Bind the right intelligence to each participant.
A conversation, together
Follow each participant’s work, exchange findings, and step in with text or images.
Pick up where you left off
Keep sessions on your machine and return to earlier work. Make tool approvals part of the workflow.

zh-cn.label: 智能体协作工作空间
zh-cn.tagline:
不同的智能，
共同的方向。
zh-cn.description: 让模型与 ACP 智能体在本地工作空间相遇。分配角色、交流发现，一起把想法变成成果。
zh-cn.short: 让模型与智能体在本地工作空间协同完成任务。
features: 由你组建的团队
连接模型 Provider 与 ACP 智能体，为每个参与者选择适合的智能。
让协作持续发生
查看各方进展、交换发现，随时通过文字或图片直接参与交流。
继续未完成的工作
会话保存在本机，随时恢复。工具审批融入工作流程，让重要操作清晰可见。

en.label: A little closer to you
en.tagline:
A quiet presence.
A helping hand.
en.description: A desktop companion powered by your local Caelis or Codex runtime. Talk, share files, and keep useful notes close while it works.
en.short: A desktop companion connected to your local Caelis or Codex.
features: Always nearby
An expressive desktop character and a quiet menu-bar home. Move it, resize it, or hide it when you need space.
A conversation that gets things done
Ask a question or hand off a task. Share files, follow progress, and step in when your input is needed.
Notes that stay with you
Keep useful notes close at hand. Read and edit them together with your Bot.

zh-cn.label: 离你更近一点
zh-cn.tagline:
安静的陪伴，
随时的帮手。
zh-cn.description: 桌面上的小伙伴，接入本机 Caelis 或 Codex。聊几句、分享文件、记下重要的事，让它帮你完成任务。
zh-cn.short: 接入本机 Caelis 或 Codex，陪在桌面上，随时准备帮忙。
features: 随时在你身边
生动的桌面角色与安静的菜单栏入口。可以移动、缩放，也可以暂时隐藏。
从聊几句，到做点事
问一个问题，或交给它一项任务。分享文件、跟进进展，在需要时参与决策。
记下重要的事
让有用的笔记留在身边，随时和 Bot 一起阅读、整理与修改。

en.label: Speak the same protocol
en.description: Build ACP agents and clients in Go, with typed APIs and managed stdio processes. An independent community SDK for an open ecosystem.
en.short: Build ACP agents and clients with typed Go APIs.
features: Both sides of ACP
Implement an agent or connect your editor, terminal, or application to one.
A clear compatibility contract
ACP v1 types generated from the official schema, with documented upgrade boundaries.
Process lifecycle, handled
Ordered notifications, cancellation, bounded queues, and explicit subprocess shutdown.

zh-cn.label: 用同一种协议交流
zh-cn.tagline:
你的智能体，
更多的可能。
zh-cn.description: 使用类型明确的 Go API 与受管理的 stdio 进程构建 ACP Agent 和 Client。面向开放生态，可独立使用的社区 SDK。
zh-cn.short: 用类型明确的 Go API 构建 ACP Agent 与 Client。
features: 连接协议的两端
实现智能体，或为编辑器、终端与应用接入 ACP 智能体。
清晰的兼容边界
从官方 schema 生成 ACP v1 类型，并提供明确的升级说明。
管理完整生命周期
有序通知、取消、受限队列，以及显式的子进程关闭流程。

en.label: Context that carries forward
en.tagline:
Remember what matters.
Build on what’s known.
en.description: An embeddable memory system for agent hosts. Durable evidence, scoped retrieval, and explicit governance behind a small model-facing interface.
en.short: Durable, governed memory you can embed in an agent host.
features: A small interface
Expose remember and recall while your host keeps control of identity, permissions, and context.
Evidence you can trace
Durable receipts and authorization-first retrieval keep provenance close to every result.
Independent by design
Embed the Go module in your own host. An optional Steward supports structured memory processing.

zh-cn.label: 让上下文延续
zh-cn.tagline:
记住重要的事，
从已有认知出发。
zh-cn.description: 可嵌入 Agent Host 的记忆系统。在简洁的模型接口背后，提供持久证据、有范围的检索和明确的数据治理。
zh-cn.short: 可嵌入 Agent Host 的持久、可治理记忆系统。
features: 简洁的模型接口
暴露 remember 与 recall，让宿主负责身份、权限和上下文。
可追溯的证据
持久回执与授权优先的检索，让每个结果保留清晰来源。
可以独立集成
将 Go 模块嵌入自己的宿主，可选的 Steward 提供结构化记忆处理。

en.label: An open desktop workbench
en.tagline:
A desktop home
for your agents.
en.description: An ACP-first desktop workbench for coding agents. Explore the early beta and help shape a lightweight, protocol-driven client.
en.short: An ACP-first desktop workbench, taking shape in the open.
features: ACP comes first
Launch a local stdio agent, negotiate the protocol, and work in a workspace-scoped session.
Follow the work
Read streaming messages, reasoning, tool calls, and plans in a desktop interface.
Built in the open
An early beta for developers. Production packaging and downloads are not available yet.

zh-cn.label: 开放的桌面工作台
zh-cn.tagline:
让智能体，
拥有桌面工作台。
zh-cn.description: 面向编码智能体、以 ACP 为先的桌面工作台。探索早期 Beta，一起完善轻量、由协议驱动的客户端。
zh-cn.short: 以 ACP 为先，正在开放构建的桌面智能体工作台。
features: 以 ACP 为先
启动本地 stdio 智能体、协商协议，在指定工作区中建立会话。
看见工作的过程
在桌面界面阅读流式消息、思考过程、工具调用与计划。
在开放中成长
目前面向开发者的早期 Beta，尚无生产安装包或公开下载。
